installation: Supabase SQL Editor; copied exact tested SQL file through native editor; transaction; no business data writes
timingMethod: Same authenticated Chrome tab. Each trial reloads dashboard first, arms click capture, then clicks Orders navigation. MutationObserver detects populated .admin-orders-table, followed by two requestAnimationFrame callbacks. REST resource entries started after that click provide API count and last responseEnd. No business mutations.
limitations: Five trials per version, same browser and account, network can vary.
This measures dashboard-to-orders navigation, not page reload or authentication.
Before displays all 66 active orders; after intentionally displays first 50 and provides pagination for the rest.
Two animation frames approximate display readiness, not an externally recorded physical display timestamp.
New asset first load is retained in post-deployment trials.
